resolved.description:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Newlines[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

[b]\n[/b] is useful, but it can be a bit of a pain if we’re trying to format lots of multiline text.
 
There’s another way though! Newlines are automatically added for strings created using [b]three quotes[/b].
[s0l0!-header][b]For example:[/b][/s0l0!-header] [code format="py" codeId="3887"]print("""this
is a
multiline
text""") [/code] 
[note]This makes it easier to format long, multi-line texts without the need to explicitly put \n for line breaks.[/note]
